title: PDQC Finding
description: The single structured shape every inspector emits and the QA Chair consumes. A finding without a location and a concrete impact is invalid and is dropped before triage.

inspector.description: One entry normally; multiple only after the Chair merges a cross-inspector duplicate.

principle.description: The universal (stack-independent) principle this finding violates, in one sentence.

evidence.description: The concrete observation. For convention-derived findings, state BOTH the deviation and the established convention it breaks.

impact.description: What concretely goes wrong for a future developer or in production if unaddressed. Required — no speculative or cosmetic-only impacts.

recommendation.description: The change to make, written as an instruction for the PRD Implementor. Never a code edit performed by PDQC.

classification.description: Assigned by the QA Chair at triage, not by the inspector. Inspectors may leave this null.

source.description: convention_derived = inferred from the code's own patterns; standards_doc = violates a documented repo standard; seed_checklist = matched a Jira-calibrated recurring pattern.

standard_ref.description: When source=standards_doc: the doc + section that defines the violated rule.

seed_pattern_ref.description: When source=seed_checklist: the seed pattern id this finding instantiates.
